messages.content:
Risk: Fraud, scams, manipulation
Description: Using AI systems to gain a personal advantage over others such as through cheating, fraud, scams, blackmail or targeted manipulation of beliefs or behavior. Examples include AI-facilitated plagiarism for research or education, impersonating a trusted or fake individual for illegitimate financial benefit, or creating humiliating or sexual imagery.
Concern: None
Policy: Fraud

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/SecuritiesIssuance/MuniIssuance/RemarketingAgent: remarketing agent — None [found by 5/7 queries]
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/AgentsAndPeople/Agents/AutomatedSystem: automated system — system that reduces or eliminates the need for human involvement in order to complete a task [found by 4/7 queries]
  Siblings: party, software agent, Agent
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakeDisinformation: Deepfake Disinformation — Use of AI-generated synthetic media depicting individuals saying or doing things they did not, created intentionally to deceive and manipulate audiences. [found by 5/7 queries]
  Siblings: State-Sponsored Propaganda, Conspiracy Theory Promotion
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000146: Artificial Language — A Language that is developed through conscious planning and premeditation, rather than one that was developed through use and repetition. [found by 5/7 queries]
  Siblings: Natural Language
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 5/7 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/SecuritiesIssuance/MuniIssuance/SecuritiesUnderwritingIssuanceProcess: securities underwriting issuance process — The process by which debt instruments are offered to the market by a syndicate of underwriters who underwrite the issue. [from restriction: facililtatesRemarketing on RemarketingAgent]
  Siblings: equity demutualization process, debt auction process, registered security issuance process

axes.rationale: Deepfake Disinformation is a specific example of how AI can be used to manipulate beliefs or behavior, which is central to the risk of fraud, scams, and manipulation.
Automated systems are the tools used to perform the actions described in the risk, such as creating fraudulent content or impersonating individuals.
